method: Median of per-run percentiles; not pooled-sample percentiles. Min/max preserve between-run variation. Batch latency includes waiting within its group, never divided by batch size.

metadata.scope: QD1 serial durable transactions; API submission separate from persistence; no cold-cache or physical power-loss claim
metadata.percentiles: Each result reports its own samples. Compare per-run percentiles; do not merge percentiles as if they were raw samples.
metadata.load_control: No CPU pinning, frequency lock, cache dropping or control of unrelated system workloads.

recovery.model: versioned independently header-checked CRC32C frames; monotonic sequence; bounded edits retaining removed+inserted bytes and parent IDs; SHA256 immutable-base identity; synced HEAD selection; original/private base and WAL retained across Ctrl+S
recovery.partial_tail: explicit recovered-prefix status; complete corrupt frames and corrupted length headers rejected; no resynchronization past corruption
recovery.acknowledgment: durable revision acknowledged only after checked sync; failed sync may still leave readable unacknowledged data
recovery.limitations: fork/_exit checkpoints, NOT physical power-loss simulation; warm page-cache reopen; owned0600 fixtures; no metadata or cross-device generalization
